I think about this kind of thing sometimes. I think the best way to start would be to start a new country. Make it a peaceful, technologically advanced utopia with a high standard of living. That will attract people. Make friends with other nations. Don't let world conflicts factor into who you ally with. Try and get everyone on your side. Be the guy that everyone goes to when they have problems, try and negotiate to get closer to world peace. Poor countries will want to join you, if you let them. Start making a massive union of people across the world. Rich countries will be difficult to convince. Either win them over with your infinite charm, or bomb the shit out of them and they won't be a problem anymore.

Alternatively, you can assassinate every world leader and place a puppet in office in every country. Then announce your plan to unite them all under one. Have massive statues built in your honor.
Kill everybody but your friends, and build a new world out of that. As an aside, can I be your friend?

I think the most important thing is to make sure you don't accidentally do harm. It's very, very hard to govern, and I don't think any country in the world right now has a great government. Remove borders and you 1) have huge issues with infrastructure and 2) have a bunch of people really angry that world interests are being valued over local interests. I think that the number one thing that would even make such a unified world possible (besides violent conquest, which would probably not last long anyway) is if the culture of every country in the world became more compassionate and less focused on economic competition.
